title: Best-Selling Fiberglass Pool Models of 2026
summary: Explore Latham's top-selling fiberglass pools, matched to small yards, spas, family, or fitness needs. Learn specifics and explore pool options with Latham Pool.
body_markdown:
Fiberglass pools are beloved for their smooth surface, eye-catching appearance, and ease of maintenance. The best fiberglass pool for your lifestyle depends on how you use it. Whether you envision swimming morning laps to jumpstart your day or coming home to poolside cocktails, Latham has a 70+ year reputation for building breathtaking fiberglass pools, designed to complement your outdoor lifestyle. Backed by industry-leading warranties, decades-long durability, and attention to aesthetics and details, every[Latham pool](https://www.lathampool.com/why-buy-latham/) combines modern innovation with exceptional craftsmanship.


## Why Fiberglass Pools Are So Popular


Fiberglass pools are popular for good reason. In addition to being intensely durable, each is made from a single, handcrafted fiberglass pool shell. This speeds time to installation, allowing you to begin enjoying your beautiful new pool sooner.


In addition to a smooth surface that’s comfortable underfoot,


[fiberglass pools have an added benefit](https://www.lathampool.com/blog/plan/fiberglass-vs-concrete-pools/) when it comes to upkeep. Their non-porous surface provides greater resistance to algae clinging to pool walls compared to rough materials like concrete. This translates to less time spent tending to your pool and more time enjoying it.


## Top 10 Best Selling Fiberglass Pools of 2026


Fiberglass pools are both easy on the eyes and easy on the upkeep. Arguably, the hardest part of owning a fiberglass pool is deciding on a model that fully realizes the vision you have for your backyard. Latham fiberglass pools are offered in a range of sizes, with built-in features that give each its own distinct personality.


If you’re thinking about dipping a toe in the waters of pool ownership but aren’t sure where to start, we’d like to introduce you to 10 of our best-selling fiberglass pools.


### 1. Corinthian


Topping the list of our best-selling


[fiberglass pools,](https://www.lathampool.com/fiberglass-pools/) the full lineup of our


[Corinthian collection](https://www.lathampool.com/products/corinthian-collection/) took top honors. Each of these rectangular pools comes fully outfitted with swim-up seating, a generous tanning ledge, and is autocover-ready. The only differentiator is size, giving more opportunities to find a version that works with your unique space.


- The


**Corinthian 16** measures 15’ x 10” x 40 and has a depth of 3’6” to 7’, making it a fit for spacious backyards where entertaining guests and endless relaxation are the order of the day.


- The


**Corinthian 14** , at 14’ x 30’ with a depth of 3’5” to 6’, strikes the perfect balance between lounging poolside and lively get-togethers.


- The


**Corinthian 12** measures 12’ x 25’ and is ideal for smaller yards or homeowners who want a pool that offers plenty of amenities despite its scaled-down size. Its depth ranges between 3’6” to 5’5”. The Corinthian 12 is equally suited to swimming laps as it is to hosting intimate poolside gatherings.


### 2. Claremont


Another rectangular model, the


[Claremont](https://www.lathampool.com/products/claremont/) offers stylish simplicity in a 14’ x 30’ package. Its depth ranges from 3’7” in the shallow end to 5’4” at its deepest point. Slip-resistant steps make it a great choice for younger and older swimmers alike, while swim-up seating makes it an inviting place to enjoy a beverage and good conversation. The Claremont is also autocover-ready, giving pool owners more options to make their pool safer and easier to care for.


### 3. Olympia 16


The


[Olympia 16](https://www.lathampool.com/products/olympia-16/) is a standout favorite among our


[Olympia collection](https://www.lathampool.com/products/olympia-collection/) . At 16’ x 35’ with a depth of 3’6” to 6’6”, the Olympia 16 is a rectangular pool with sleek lines, swim-up seating, and an autocover-ready profile. Slip-resistant scalloped steps add a striking visual element to the pool, making it a great fit for homeowners who love to entertain poolside and also favor a splash of the unexpected alongside a more traditional look.


For a slightly more compact version ideal for smaller yards, the Olympia 14 also made our list of best-selling pools. It measures 14’ x 30’ with a depth of 3’6” to 6’ – with all the same features as its larger counterpart.


### 4. Bermuda


The


[Bermuda collection](https://www.lathampool.com/products/bermuda-collection/) earned several spots on our list of best-sellers, with the Bermuda 12 and Bermuda 14 standing at the top, and the Bermuda 16.35 trailing just slightly behind. What makes each of these


[freeform pools](https://www.lathampool.com/freeform-shaped-pools/) so special is their assortment of features and the Deluxe option that pairs a relaxing spillover spa alongside this lagoon-shaped sanctuary. Each Bermuda model features swim-up seating and a wide top step that can double as a smaller tanning ledge or shallow wading area for kids. Here’s a closer look at the dimensions of each:


- The


**Bermuda 12** measures 12’ x 26’ with a depth of 3’6 to 5’6.


- The


**Bermuda 14** measures 14’ x 30’ with a depth of 3’6 to 6’.


- The


**Bermuda 16.35** measures 16’ x 35 with a depth of 3’6 to 6’6.


- The


**Bermuda 16.40** measures 16’ x 40’ with a depth of 3’6 to 6’6.


### 5. Monaco


The


[Monaco](https://www.lathampool.com/products/monaco/) is a spacious 16’ x 40’ rectangular pool with a depth of 3’6” in the shallow end and an 8’ depth made for floating your cares away. Slip-resistant steps, swim-up seating, and an autocover-ready design make it an ideal fit for hosting multi-generational gatherings, with an ample shallow end for younger swimmers and a deeper end for adults and teens to splash.


### 6. Kingston


Whether your vibe is sophisticated, sporty, or soothing, the


[Kingston](https://www.lathampool.com/products/kingston/) is a rectangular pool that fits every mood. This top-selling autocover-ready 16’ x 38’ pool has a depth of 3’6” in the shallow end and 5’10” at its deepest point. Swim-up seating and slip-resistant steps offer spots to socialize, rest in between laps, or an easy entrance or exit to the pool – made with swimmers of all ages in mind.


### 7. Astoria


The


[Astoria collection](https://www.lathampool.com/products/astoria/) brings together the stylish simplicity of a rectangular pool with the ultimate relaxation of a built-in spa. Each Astoria model, regardless of size, has all the same indulgent features, including swim-up seating, multiple entry and exit points, and a roomy tanning ledge that doubles as a splash pad for kids to play. Slip-resistant steps and an autocover-ready profile add thoughtful touches for safer swimming experiences.


- The


**Astoria 12** measures 12’ x 28” with a depth of 3’ to 5’7”; its accompanying spa has a 3’ depth.


- The


**Astoria 14** measures 14’ x 35” with a depth of 3’6” to 6’6”; its adjoining spa has a 3’ depth.


- The


**Astoria 16** measures 15’10”’ x 40” with a 3’6” to 7’ depth; its built-in spillover spa has a 3’ depth.


### 8. Barcelona


Made with fun, relaxation, and a touch of whimsy in mind, the 16’ x 38’


[Barcelona](https://www.lathampool.com/products/barcelona/) is a rectangular pool well-suited to memorable get-togethers or long, lazy evenings spent poolside or floating along its impressive length. It has a depth of 3’6” at its most shallow point and a deep end of 7’. Curved entry steps are molded into a playful wave pattern, giving it a distinctive touch. Swim-up seating, multiple entry and exit points, and slip-resistant steps make this autocover-ready pool ready for whatever suits your pleasure.


### 9. Milan


Small in size, but big on fun, the


[10’ x 20’ Milan](https://www.lathampool.com/products/milan-10-20/) is the most compact entry on our list of best-selling fiberglass pools. Good things come in small packages, especially if you have a smaller yard or want less pool to maintain. This rectangular-shaped


[plunge pool](https://www.lathampool.com/plunge-pools/) has a depth of 4’10”, making the Milan ideal for adult swimmers who want the best of multiple worlds. Kick back with a cocktail poolside with your feet dangling in the water, swim morning laps, or host a small gathering with just enough space to let your hair down and get wet. It features a shallow wading area (with 14” to 18” of water”), swim-up seating, and is autocover ready.


### 10. Apollo 14


A marriage of stunning style and fun-yet-functional features, the


[Apollo 14](https://www.lathampool.com/products/apollo-14/) rounds out our list of best-sellers. It measures 13’ x 10” x 32’ with a depth of 3’6” (in the shallows) to 6’1” (at its deepest point). Integrated features make the autocover-ready Apollo 14 ideal for busy families who want a pool that can do it all. A wide tanning ledge pulls double duty as a shallow play area for young children, while swim-up-seating that extends fully around the perimeter, making the Apollo 14 the place to be for relaxed conversations. Multiple entry and exit points with slip-resistant steps add a practical touch to this enchanting backyard escape.


## Best Options for Small Backyards


Having a smaller backyard area doesn’t mean you can’t enjoy the fun of a pool. Latham offers a variety of fiberglass pool options that can transform smaller spaces into an enticing retreat.


- [Astoria 12](https://www.lathampool.com/products/astoria-12/) **– Best for:** Young couples or empty-nesters who love to entertain. A built-in spa, tanning ledge, and lounging bench make the Astoria 12 ideal for maximizing relaxation and recreation.


- [Axiom 12](https://www.lathampool.com/products/axiom-12/) **– Best for:** Young families or sophisticated sunbathers. An eye-catching compact freeform pool, the Axiom 12 has a spacious tanning ledge meant for sunning and a tidy length made for splashing.


- [Bermuda 12](https://www.lathampool.com/products/bermuda-12/) **– Best for:** Small get-togethers and moonlit relaxation. Swim-up seating and tiered steps make the Bermuda 12 a treat for quaint gatherings full of good conversation and wading in the water. Its winding curves offer a relaxing effect after a long day.


- [Cape Cod 12](https://www.lathampool.com/products/cape-cod-12/) **– Best for:** The pool owner who wants a little bit of everything. Its unique shape – not quite a rectangle, not quite a freeform pool – makes the Cape Cod 12 perfect for whatever suits your mood. From swimming laps to lounging on a sunny afternoon.


Explore more options and get inspired with our


[small pools guide](https://www.lathampool.com/blog/research/how-small-of-a-pool-is-too-small/) .


## Best Options for Families


The hustle and bustle of family life needs a pool that can keep up with everyone. A pool creates a space to make memories and can pack in all the fun of a family vacation, without leaving home. Here are some of our picks for fiberglass pools for families.


- [Bermuda Collection](https://www.lathampool.com/products/bermuda-collection/) **– Best for:** Families of all sizes. From a compact 12’ x 26’ model to a large 16’ x 40’ option, the Bermuda collection has tons of fun features (including an optional spillover spa on Deluxe models, perfect for parents who need to take it easy after minding the kids!) and plenty of space to play. Swim-up seating and a tanning ledge that doubles as a kiddie wading area offers a little something for everybody.


- [Aruba](https://www.lathampool.com/products/aruba/) **– Best for:** Families with young swimmers. For kids just learning to doggie paddle and parents who want a place to kick back themselves, the Aruba is a compact freeform pool that measures just 11’ x 22’. Multiple entry points, swim-up-seating, and slip-resistant steps are ideal for when kids get tired and are ready to get out of the pool for the day and let the adults have a chance to enjoy it.


## Best Options for Relaxation


There’s nothing quite like a beautiful pool to transform your backyard with tranquil waters reminiscent of your favorite destination. Some pools are made for relaxation, ready to serve as the perfect backdrop for your morning coffee or a moonlit swim after work.


- [Apollo 14](https://www.lathampool.com/products/apollo-14/) **– Best for:** Sunbathing and swimming. The Apollo 14 boasts a wide tanning ledge for soaking up sun without fully immersing yourself in the water. However, if you choose to go for a swim, multiple entry/exit points let you decide when it’s time to go back to taking it easy.


- [Ariel 16](https://www.lathampool.com/products/ariel-16/) **– Best for:** Social hours and sunshine. An expansive tanning ledge makes the Ariel 16 great for catching some rays, while its 40’ length and swim-up seating offer ample room for guests to splash, sip, and socialize for a more engaging way to unwind.


- [Axiom 16](https://www.lathampool.com/products/axiom-16/) **– Best for:** Relaxation, with a side of recreation. The Axiom 16 features a built-in tanning ledge, ideal for stretching out on your favorite lounge chair with a cold drink. If you’re enjoying a good book, you can rest your eyes by gazing out at the Axiom’s entrancing freeform curves.


- [Astoria Collection](https://www.lathampool.com/products/astoria/) **– Best for:** Sunning, soothing sore muscles, and more. Regardless of size, each rectangular Astoria model features a built-in spa ideal for easing sore muscles or unwinding in warm waters after a tiring day. A wide tanning ledge also offers space to soak up some sunshine before taking a dip to cool off.


****


## Best Options for Fitness


A pool can enhance all aspects of your lifestyle, including offering a place to get gentle exercise that’s as invigorating as it is enjoyable. Here are some of our top choices for fiberglass models that blend fun and fitness.


- [Barcelona](https://www.lathampool.com/products/barcelona/) **– Best for:** Starter swim workouts and getting fit with friends and family. The Barcelona measures 16’ x 38’ with plenty of options to squeeze in some exercise. Its 38’ length makes it challenging enough for people starting an aquatic workout regimen, with multiple entry/exit points in case you get tired. It’s also wide enough to accommodate swim lanes for a bit of friendly competition while getting fit together.


- [Astoria 16](https://www.lathampool.com/products/astoria-16/) **– Best for:** Swimming laps and easing muscle aches. The Astoria 16 has similar dimensions to the Barcelona (15’ 10” x 40”), but also features a built-in spa. Whether you choose a water workout and swimming laps, or want to enjoy a relaxing soak in its built-in spa after hitting the gym, the Astoria 16 is the place to be.


## Find The Best Fiberglass Pool For Your Backyard


Every homeowner is unique, which is why there is no single best option when choosing a fiberglass pool. Rather, a pool is a reflection of their aesthetic vision to fully realize their backyard’s potential. The right model for you factors in the size of your yard, your budget, how you plan to use it, and what features complement your lifestyle.


We’ve shared just a sampling of some of our best-selling models. However, there’s so much more to explore. Take a look at


[all Latham fiberglass models](https://www.lathampool.com/fiberglass-pool-shapes/) to get an even stronger sense of what’s possible.
